name: Floating Label Field
description: A text field whose label rises into a notch cut in its hairline border. Error and success copy cross-fade in, a tick draws on success, and a count appears near the limit.

props.name: label
props.description: Resting label. It rises into the notch on the top hairline when the field is focused or filled. A label too long for the field ends in an ellipsis before the trailing slot.

props.name: helper
props.description: Helper text under the field, shown in the resting, focused and filled states.

props.name: errorText
props.description: Replaces the helper once a value has rested and failed validate, or the field is left with one in it. Every edit returns it to rest until the value settles again.

props.name: successText
props.description: Replaces the helper once a value passes validate. The tick draws beside any suffix at the same time.

props.name: state
props.description: Forces a state for review. Unset, the field follows what is typed. Disabled locks the input and dims the whole field and its helper row.

props.name: validate
props.description: Decides whether a value is acceptable. Without it the field never shows an error or the success tick, so a plain text field stays quiet.

props.name: counter
props.description: Shows the count once the value passes 80% of maxLength (32 of 40 in the demo), tweening the digits and turning to the error colour at the limit. Needs maxLength. Nothing shows at rest, so use the Value control to fill the demo.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Longest value the field accepts. The input stops at this length, and the count reads against it.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Leading slot, such as an icon. Its measured width sets where the label and the text start, with a 10px gap.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Trailing slot, such as a unit or a short word. Its measured width sets the text's right inset. The success tick sits beside it.

props.name: size
props.description: 56px or 64px tall. Text steps from 16px to 18px so it stays above the iOS zoom threshold.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black field with white ink, or the white inverse on paper.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled: the value on first render. A filled field rests with its label already on the line.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled: the value. Pair it with onValueChange so the host owns the state.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called on every change, and when Chrome autofills the field, with the current value.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root, for width or margin in the host layout.

controls.label: Helper
controls.default: We’ll send receipts and invoices here.
